questions.q: According to the video, about how much thread could one skilled spinner make by hand in a day?
questions.why: The script states a hand spinner made about one pound of thread a day.

questions.q: A factory has 50 machines, and each machine makes 20 items per day. How many items are made each day in total?
questions.why: Using output = machines x items per machine per day, 50 x 20 = 1000 items per day.

questions.q: What powered the machines in the factories during the Industrial Revolution, according to the video?
questions.why: The script says coal-fired steam engines supplied the power to run the machines.
